einzeiler: Dax and Guy Stevenson look back on the Groundlings, bouncer days, and wild youth.
kurzfassung: Dax welcomes his longtime friend Guy Stevenson to talk about their shared history. They discuss their backgrounds in New York, getting into fistfights as bouncers, and their time at the Groundlings. They also share stories about writing legendary comedy sketches and navigating health scares later in life.
stichpunkte: Guy Stevenson shares memories of growing up on Long Island and attending concerts in his youth
Both hosts discuss their dyslexia and how they managed to overcome reading challenges in school
Guy talks about enlisting in the Marine Corps and an eventful stint in the Philippines
Memories of working as bouncers at rough bars in Los Angeles and various street fights
The origin story of Guy's famous astrophysics classroom sketch featuring Stephen Hawking voices
Guy details his history of severe heart issues, multiple open-heart surgeries, and receiving a defibrillator
A chaotic motorcycle road trip attempt to Austin, Texas in their youth

kapitel.titel: New Wave and Long Island Memories

clips.hook: Believing a totally fabricated boxing background
clips.text: The guest describes completely trusting a fake story about training at a famous boxing gym due to an intimidating first impression.

clips.hook: The inspiration behind the ultimate comedy sketch
clips.text: The guest explains how hearing a robotic voice on public radio sparked the idea for a chaotic classroom scene where everyone uses synthetic speech.

clips.hook: Waking up in a different hospital after minor surgery
clips.text: A routine shoulder procedure unexpectedly leads to a major medical emergency transfer and discovering a severe hidden infection.

beschreibung:
On this week’s episode of Mom’s Car we welcome Guy Stevenson (MADtv, Reno 911!, Punk’d). Guy, Dax, and Best Friend Aaron Weakley talk through competing for alpha status at the Groundlings, Dax’s decades-long boxing lie, getting sober in the Marines, bouncing at Jumbo’s Clown Room, the making of Dax’s all-time favorite sketch, asking a heart surgeon for a wolf upgrade, and a motorcycle road trip neither Dax nor Aaron was brave enough to cancel.
